notes: preset=medium is required for publication-grade BD-rate. preset=faster drifts BD-VMAF by ~2 pp on RD-sensitive content.
threads=1 is required for bit-exact reproducibility. threads=0 (auto) is acceptable for diagnostic sweeps but BD-rate may drift across runs.
QP-mode (constant QP) is used instead of CRF so that the 4-point R-D curve is on a fixed quality grid for the Bjontegaard delta computation.
